# Index of checklist cards

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Use every core card. For the rest, read the index of each folder below with a card whose name could apply to the paper (its field, a technique in its methods, or a kind of claim it makes; often more than one folder), and open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches. Paths are relative to this folder.

Core cards, always used: core/availability.md, core/uncertainty.md, core/controls.md, core/processing.md, core/evidence.md, core/consistency.md, core/statistics.md.
